title: Utillian 50 Magnetic Adapter Silver
description:
AVAILABLE IN SILVER COLOR

BROAD COMPATIBILITY
The Utillian 50 Magnetic Adapter Set is equipped with two versatile magnetic adapters that offer universal flexibility. These adapters accommodate 0.5 ml and 1.2 ml cartridges, making it a versatile tool for anyone who enjoys vaping.

CUTTING-EDGE DESIGN
The Utillian 50 Magnetic Adapter Set showcases a forward-thinking design that marries innovation with precision. Specifically engineered to accommodate a wide range of 510 cartridges, this set guarantees a perfect fit and allows for smooth transitions between different cartridge sizes.

BUILT TO LAST
Constructed with durability in mind, the Utillian 50 Magnetic Adapter Set is made from high-quality materials to ensure long-lasting performance. Each adapter is carefully designed to fit specific cartridge sizes, providing a reliable and consistent connection with every use.

USER-FRIENDLY EXPERIENCE
With ease of use at its core, the Utillian 50 Magnetic Adapter Set is designed for quick and simple cartridge changes. The magnetic connection allows for fast swaps, whether you’re relaxing at home or out and about, ensuring a seamless experience.

Cartridge not included
